summary: Dual cross-modulated Atari Punk Console: two `apc` nodes feed each other's frequency (`fm`) and width (`width_mod`) at audio rate, so each pulse train shapes the other. `ratio1`/`ratio2` tune the two astables (note-derived Q16 ratios), `width1`/`width2` are the monostable widths (Q16 samples, absolute time), and `xf12`/`xw12`/`xf21`/`xw21` are the four cross-mod depths (Q15, unity = full). The two outputs sum through `level` and a `dc_block` removes the pulse DC. Each cross-mod path has a `delay1` breaker so the graph cycle resolves, the modulation is therefore one sample late (standard audio-rate feedback). Set the depths below unity for subtle chaos, at unity for the full aggressive DAPC.
